tasks.title: Write briefing dialogue for all 4 character arcs
tasks.description: Each character has a one-liner that plays before the daily puzzle — their briefing expression. Several chapters are missing these lines. Go through each of the 4 characters (Zix, Brix, Pip, The Cartographer) and write the missing ones. ~20-30 short lines total. Match each character's established voice and arc position.

tasks.title: Write arc 1 completion screen copy for each character
tasks.description: When a player finishes a character's arc, a reward screen marks the moment. Write the copy for all 4 characters: a short headline and 2-3 sentences. Should feel personal to each character and earned. This is the last thing a player sees for arc 1 — it needs to land.

tasks.title: Write button guide copy for mining and debrief screens
tasks.description: Players don't know what the buttons do. Write plain-language labels and a one-sentence description for each key button on the mining screen (sell, scrap, keep, drone, return to base) and the mission debrief screen. Short, clear, no jargon. These will render inside a small help overlay.

tasks.title: Write copy and flow for the Starter Rocket 2 unlock screen
tasks.description: When a player hits level 3, SR2 unlocks but nothing meaningful happens. Write the screen copy — headline, what stats to highlight (2x speed, 2x range, 1.5x cargo), and the CTA. Also describe the visual flow: what shows on screen, in what order, for how long. This is the spec the developer needs to implement it.

tasks.title: Write visual personality notes for 3 fish species
tasks.description: The artist needs direction before animating the fish. For 3 early-level species (e.g. Blue Chromis, Parrotfish, Clownfish), write a short profile for each: how it moves, how it reacts to the player, what mood it gives off. ~150 words each. This goes directly to the artist as a brief — be visual and specific.

tasks.title: Document typography and colour tokens for the 3.0 redesign
tasks.description: The 3.0 redesign is blocked without a locked design token foundation. Document the decisions: which fonts at which weights, colour palette with hex values (teal/amber/sky + neutrals), spacing scale, and dark/light mode variants. Write it as a short markdown spec — not a full design system, just the decisions locked down so the developer can build from them.
